source: JPX monthly listed-issues catalogue (TSE sector/market) + Yahoo Finance unofficial daily close and volume
universe_note: JP uses JPX-listed domestic ordinary-share codes across Prime, Standard and Growth. US uses S&P 500 members plus largest sector-classified US-listed equities/ADRs, not the whole U.S. market. Screening quotes are collected in rolling daily batches. RS 1–99 ranks are provisional within fresh quoted stocks only, not necessarily all public companies.

method.high52_distance_pct: Distance from highest available daily closing price of last up to 252 sessions
method.rvol20: Last completed volume divided by mean volume of prior 20 sessions
method.market_cap: Nasdaq-screener-derived market cap snapshots for US listings, USD, as-of collection date. Not a real-time valuation. For JP, only show if a verified capitalisation feed with date/currency is available.
method.rs_universe_pct: IBD-inspired proxy 1–99 percentile rank of 0.4*63d+0.2*126d+0.2*189d+0.2*252d price returns among fresh eligible stocks in the current market universe. Not IBD's proprietary rating, and not a percentile across all listed stocks.
method.rs_weighted_return_pct: Approximate weighted trailing returns, with horizons 63/126/189/252 completed sessions and weights 40/20/20/20 (%).
method.rs_sp500_delta_pp: US stocks only: weighted trailing price return minus S&P 500 (^GSPC) over the same horizons, percentage points, only with exactly matching last close dates.
method.sector_rank: 60-session return rank only among recently priced same-sector stocks, not necessarily all listed names
method.beta_252d: Covariance of individual and benchmark daily closing-price returns divided by benchmark variance, last at most 252 returns and at least 120 matched observations. Japan benchmark TOPIX ETF 1306.T; US S&P500 ^GSPC.
method.sharpe_252d: Annualized mean daily close-to-close return divided by sample standard deviation times sqrt(252), risk-free rate assumed zero; last at most 252 returns, at least 120.
